To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
implementation intentions can be used to increase the effectiveness of interventions to reduce dietary fat consumption.

(1) Implementation intention training is a promising intervention for reducing fat intake in adults; (2) Implementation intention training may be a promising intervention for promoting physical activity; (3) Implementation intention training appears not to be effective for increasing fruit and vegetable intake; and (4) Implementation intention training does not appear to be an effective strategy to promote weight loss in adults.

the implementation intentions (IFs) strategy can reduce fat intake.
